versions.summary: Demo-only preview. Connectors: MetaTrader 5 (one broker installer tested). Draft values below need the Product Owner's confirmation of what was actually tested for this version.

operating_systems.name: Ubuntu 24.04 LTS
operating_systems.notes: Tested on 24.04.5, kernel 6.8. Other systems are refused at setup.

runtime.notes: Installed and pinned by the provisioning tool.
From Ubuntu; MT5 warns it prefers Wine 10 or later. CONFIRM: recent broker-dialog work targeted Wine 11.20.

connectors.name: MetaTrader 5
connectors.notes: Installed from one broker's own installer, on a demo account. CONFIRM: recent work referenced build 6283.

limitations.title: Demo accounts only
limitations.description: An open security question (#74) about where MT5/Wine may leave broker credentials outside the temporary session means only demo broker accounts are supported for now.

limitations.title: Not verified end-to-end on a real VPS
limitations.description: The Get-started steps were tested separately; a complete first run from the dashboard with a real MT5 terminal on a real server has not been recorded as one run.

limitations.title: Trading API orders not fully verified
limitations.description: Opt-in per deployment, demo accounts only. A real order was accepted once by an FTMO demo account but no verified filled or closed outcome; fills, closing, duplicate requests and reconciliation are not verified yet.

limitations.title: Sessions run once (no continuous mode yet)
limitations.description: Continuous always-on sessions that survive a reboot are not available yet; a session runs once and is not restarted automatically.

limitations.title: No automatic backups
limitations.description: No backups of servers or MT5 data are made.

limitations.title: Removing a server does not close broker positions
limitations.description: Deleting a container or server does not close positions; remove every deployment first (needs the agent connected). Docker, containerd and runtime images stay on the host, and a removed server's host key cannot be trusted again.

limitations.title: Only MetaTrader 5 is supported
limitations.description: cTrader and other connectors are planned for later milestones; only MT5 is available today.
